name: Quickstep
heading: Quickstep Traits
sourceDistinctions: Startling Speed imposes attack disadvantage after movement. The effect is limited to attack disadvantage. Character level sets the daily round count. The corrected printing gives Small size.
The book grants Fey Ancestry and leaves the creature type implicit in the player traits. Humanoid is the table ruling for this example.

name: Ratatosk
heading: Ratatosk Racial Traits, Ekorre and Tradvakt
sourceDistinctions: Both Ekorre and Tradvakt share the printed Strength reduction and Dexterity increase. Ekorre differ in size, weapon handling and magic. Tradvakt use Constitution for War Chatter.
Grounded Celestial is a targeting rule. It does not change the character’s Humanoid type.
